✨ **A Little Light Inside Me** ✨

Today, we got to know a very special lady who loved children with all her heart - 
Dr. Maria Montessori 🌱💛

Our teachers wrote a beautiful little story about her life and shared it with us. As we listened, we discovered something magical: each one of us has a little light inside us! ✨

And do you know what makes our light shine brighter?

🌟 When we 'try something new'
🤝 When we 'help our friends'
💡 When we 'freethink for ourselves'
🌱 When we 'keep trying'
💛 And when 'we work together peacefully'

We realised that independence isn't just about doing things alone. It is about having the confidence to say:

“Let me try!”
“I can do it!”
“I can do it myself!” 🙌

And that is exactly what Dr Montessori dreamed for every child - a child who is 'confident, capable, curious, and free to discover what they can do.'

So today, we didn't just hear about her dream...

WE LIVE IT AND FLOURISH ✨

🌟 Because every “I can” makes our little light shine brighter - and every shining child helps light up the world. 🌍💛

🌿✨ **From the Classroom to the Great Outdoors!** ✨🌿

What better way to bring learning to life than by stepping into nature itself? 💚

Our little Freethinkers had a delightful field trip to Lalbagh Botanical Garden, where classroom conversations came alive all around them! 🌳🦋🐦

With curious eyes and eager minds, they explored Land and Water forms, spotted Animals, Birds and Tiny Bugs, and discovered the many wonders of the natural world. 🌎

And then came a wonderful connection to something they had learned just yesterday—the beautiful Bonsai Garden, introducing them to a fascinating art form from Japan. 🇯🇵🌱 Seeing it in person made the learning meaningful, memorable and exciting!

For our little Freethinkers, this was more than a field trip—it was an opportunity to Observe, Discover, Make Connections and Learn through direct experience. 🌿✨

A joyful day of exploration, wonder and purposeful learning! 💚

🇮🇳✨ A Week of Culture, Connection & Celebration at TFS! ✨🇮🇳

What a beautiful Independence Week it has been across The Freethinking Schools! ❤️

Our celebrations brought children, parents, grandparents, and teachers together to explore the many colours, traditions, and stories that make India so wonderfully diverse.

From proudly wearing and sharing the traditional attire of different Indian states 👘 to creating Rangolis 🎨, making Leaf Torans 🍃, and stringing Flower Garlands 🌸, our children experienced India’s rich cultural heritage through hands-on learning.

📸 Wings of Peace – Peace Begins With Me

Our special Independence Week Photo Booth carried a beautiful message inspired by the white band of our National Flag, which represents peace.

With our “Wings of Peace”, we encouraged every child to discover that peace is not just something we hope for in the world—it is something that begins with each one of us.

A kind word.
A helping hand.
Respect for others.
Choosing kindness over conflict. 🕊️

Our photo booth became a beautiful space for children and families to pause, connect, smile, and reflect on this important value together.

A heartfelt thank you to all our parents, grandparents, children, and teachers for making Independence Week so joyful, meaningful, and memorable. ❤️

At TFS, we believe that when children experience culture, celebrate diversity, and practise peace, they begin to understand what it truly means to be part of a nation.

🇮🇳 Celebrating our freedom. Embracing our diversity. Spreading our wings of peace.

**Peace begins with me.** 🕊️

✈️🧳 **Passport? ✔️ Suitcase? ✔️ Adventure? Absolutely!** 🇷🇺

This week, our little travellers buckled up and boarded the **Freethinking Jet Plane** for an unforgettable adventure to RUSSIA - the largest country in Asia!

From the moment they "landed," our classrooms came alive with discovery as the children:
🇷🇺 Explored Moscow, Russia's vibrant capital
👋 Learned to greet one another in the Russian language
🏰 Visited some of Russia's most iconic landmarks
🩰 Twirled gracefully through the world of Russian ballet
🪆 Crafted their very own colourful Matryoshka (nesting) dolls, strengthening their creativity and fine motor skills along the way

Every destination in our "Around the World" journey opens a window into a new culture, helping children develop curiosity, appreciation for diversity, confidence, and a deeper understanding of the beautiful world they are part of.

🌍 Because when children experience the world with their hands, hearts, and minds, they don't just learn about different cultures, they begin to celebrate them!

✈️ Where will the Freethinking Jet Plane take us next?

📚✨ Reading Week at The Freethinking School ✨

The joy of a story is even greater when it's shared. ❤️

This Reading Week, our amazing parent volunteers stepped into the classroom to bring stories to life. Our little listeners were captivated by every page, every character, and every adventure.

The most beautiful moment? Watching children excitedly choose their own books afterwards, curious minds discovering the joy of reading, one story at a time. 📖🌈

Because when children fall in love with books early, they begin a lifelong journey of imagination, learning, and discovery.

A heartfelt thank you to all our wonderful parents for being a part of this special celebration. 💛

🌱 Our Tiny Tots | Learning Through Montessori 🌱 

In a Montessori environment, children learn by doing, exploring, and discovering independently. Through Practical Life and hands-on Montessori activities, our tiny tots develop: 
🤲 Fine motor skills 
🧠 Concentration and focus 
🌟 Independence and confidence 
👀 Observation and coordination 
💛 Patience, responsibility, and care 

Montessori is about creating an environment where children can do it for themselves. 🌈 Every small task and every repetition helps our little learners grow into confident, capable, and independent individuals.
